meta.title: Traficom model keys that are electric only
meta.purpose: The safer-choice comparison for an electric car compares it only with these models. A key is listed only when every car Traficom counts under it is electric, according to the maker's own page. Keys are 'make|model' as in traficom-inspections.json (lowercase, no accents).
meta.howChecked: Each URL was opened on 18.10.2026 and the quoted phrase read on the page, except Tesla's, which refuses automated requests (HTTP 403); those URLs were found on tesla.com by a web search on the same day, and Tesla builds only electric cars.
meta.hybrids: No hybrid-only list. Of the hybrid model keys, only toyota|prius, toyota|prius plus, toyota|prius plug-in hybrid and lexus|ct are hybrid only, and none of them has 800 inspections in any year (the safer choice's floor), so a hybrid comparison would always be empty. Toyota Auris, Corolla, Yaris, C-HR, RAV4, Kia Niro, Hyundai Ioniq and Lexus UX/NX/RX were also sold with petrol, diesel or fully electric versions under the same key.

notListed: audi|e-tron, jaguar|i-pace, mercedes-benz|eqc, ford|mustang mach-e and renault|zoe are electric, but no maker page for them was found on 18.10.2026 (the models are discontinued or renamed). None has 800 inspections in a year, so leaving them out changes no comparison; an ad for one gets the old behaviour unless it says the car is electric.
